problem_summary: 5 citizen complaints about 'Fixing/Reparing Potholes' were recorded in Begur between March 2019 and May 2022, spanning 3 calendar year(s). 60% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened).

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

evidence_items.description: KAUN 2022 data: ward recorded 49 pothole complaints.
20 road/drain work order(s) sanctioned in ward (₹37.9 crore, FY 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26). Note: work order ward mapping uses datameet243 numbering (exact_name join).

hypotheses: HYPOTHESIS (unverified): Road work contracts exist in this ward, yet 60% of complaints remain unresolved. This may indicate that repairs were incomplete, inadequate, or that the work was performed in different road segments. Independent verification required.
agency_attribution_note: 5 of 5 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier MEDIUM (score=0.46). Top scoring factors: recurrence_years=1.00, unresolved_rate=0.60, description_severity=0.36.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='Begur' matched to datameet243=227 via exact_name (overlap_confidence=1.0).
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for Begur for the period 2019–2022.
Request inspection records for the 20 work order(s) sanctioned in this ward to verify whether road works covered the affected stretch.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.

representative_complaints.description_excerpt: Podar International School Road was in very good condition before officials dug and did some pipeline laying work. Road has been left unattended now with no Tarring or Asphalting. My Son used to go cycling to the school and now I have stopped him and sending him by Taxi due to bad and unsafe road.

representative_complaints.subcategory: Tarring Or Asphalting Of Existing Road
representative_complaints.description_excerpt: When will the Gottigere Lake Road be asphalted, it has been really long time work was started for road widening, but unfinished. Request officials to look into this matter as soon as possible, as this road is very steep, it is really unsafe to travel during monsoons and night.

Road condition is very poor....there are only potholes in the road. And no roads...please repair the road...I use this road daily for my office travel...and face lot of issues...it is road to two schools  which is Bangalore public school and podar international school and also to nursing college...

Potholes and broken roads are making the driving  time horrible, Monsoon is making it worst.

Commute to daily errands have been difficult.

Road infrastructure is a basic necessity and I please urge you to resolve this as soon as possible.
